products.name: BPC-157
products.description: Synthetic pentadecapeptide — a 15-amino-acid partial sequence of a human gastric protein. Lyophilized powder, ≥99% purity by HPLC. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.
products.overview:
BPC-157 is one of the most frequently requested reference peptides in the preclinical literature. Each lot is synthesized to order, lyophilized under nitrogen, and released only after third-party analytical review.

Supplied in amber glass vials with crimp seals. Store lyophilized material refrigerated and protected from light.
products.mechanism: In published cell-culture work, BPC-157 has been characterized for its interactions with growth-factor signaling pathways and nitric-oxide-related enzyme systems. All available data are limited to in-vitro and preclinical models.

products.name: BPC-157 Oral
products.description: Capsule presentation of BPC-157 for laboratory stability, dissolution, and formulation research. Research use only.
products.overview: The capsule form is supplied for laboratories comparing formulation stability against the lyophilized reference material. Each bottle carries the same per-lot analytical documentation as the vial presentation.
products.mechanism: Identical peptide sequence to the vial presentation; the capsule matrix is characterized separately on each lot's certificate of analysis.

products.name: TB-500
products.description: Synthetic fragment of thymosin beta-4 (Tβ4), an actin-binding protein sequence. Lyophilized powder characterized by third-party analytical testing. Research use only.
products.overview: TB-500 corresponds to the actin-binding domain of thymosin beta-4. Lots are released with full chromatographic and mass-spectrometry documentation.
products.mechanism: In cell-based assays, the thymosin beta-4 fragment has been characterized for its role in actin monomer sequestration and cytoskeletal dynamics. Data are limited to in-vitro models.

products.name: Selank
products.description: Synthetic heptapeptide analog of the tuftsin sequence with a C-terminal extension. Lyophilized powder. Research use only.
products.overview: Selank is a tuftsin-analog heptapeptide referenced widely in preclinical neurochemistry literature. Supplied lyophilized with per-lot analytical documentation.
products.mechanism: Characterized in vitro for enzyme-inhibition activity against enkephalin-degrading peptidases and for receptor-binding profiles in preclinical neurochemistry assays.

products.name: GHK-Cu
products.description: Copper tripeptide complex (glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine : Cu²⁺). Lyophilized powder with characteristic blue color. Research use only.
products.overview: GHK-Cu is a naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide studied extensively in cell-culture models. The copper complex gives the lyophilized cake its characteristic blue color — a quick visual identity check on receipt.
products.mechanism: Studied in vitro for copper transport chemistry and for gene-expression profiling in cultured fibroblast lines. All findings are preclinical.

images.alt: GHK-Cu blue lyophilized vial, demo placeholder render

products.name: KPV
products.description: C-terminal tripeptide fragment (Lys-Pro-Val) of alpha-MSH. Lyophilized powder. Research use only.
products.overview: KPV is the C-terminal tripeptide of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, used as a compact reference ligand in melanocortin-pathway research.
products.mechanism: Characterized in vitro for binding at melanocortin-receptor family members and for downstream signaling readouts in cultured cell lines.

products.name: Thymosin Alpha-1
products.description: 28-amino-acid peptide fragment derived from prothymosin alpha. Lyophilized powder. Research use only.
products.overview: Thymosin alpha-1 is a well-characterized thymic peptide fragment with an extensive preclinical literature. Each lot ships with complete analytical documentation.
products.mechanism: Characterized in vitro for toll-like-receptor pathway signaling readouts in cultured cell models. All data are preclinical.

products.name: MOTS-C
products.description: 16-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded within the 12S rRNA region of mitochondrial DNA. Lyophilized powder. Research use only.
products.overview: MOTS-C is a mitochondrial-derived peptide of interest in cell-signaling research. Supplied lyophilized with per-lot chromatographic documentation.
products.mechanism: Characterized in cultured cell models for AMPK-pathway signaling readouts and nuclear translocation under stress conditions in vitro.

products.name: 5-Amino-1MQ
products.description: Small-molecule inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT), supplied in capsule form for laboratory enzymology research. Research use only.
products.overview: 5-Amino-1MQ is a membrane-permeable small molecule used as a reference NNMT inhibitor in enzymology work. Capsule presentation with per-lot analytical documentation.
products.mechanism: Characterized in vitro as a selective inhibitor of NNMT enzymatic activity, with published kinetic data in cell-free and cell-culture systems.

products.name: LEAN Blend
products.description: Multi-compound research blend, lyophilized, supplied for in-vitro assay development. Research use only.
products.overview:
LEAN is a fixed-ratio blend of research peptides supplied as a single lyophilized cake for laboratories running multi-analyte assay panels.

The 10mg and 30mg presentations share this product page — use the size selector to switch between them.
products.mechanism: Each constituent peptide is identified and quantified individually on the lot's certificate of analysis; the blend itself is characterized by combined chromatographic profile.

products.name: NAD+
products.description: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+), a coenzyme central to cellular redox chemistry. Lyophilized powder. Research use only.
products.overview: NAD+ is a ubiquitous redox coenzyme supplied here as a high-purity lyophilized reference material. Single vials and 4-packs share this product page — use the size selector.
products.mechanism: NAD+ participates in hydride-transfer reactions across hundreds of characterized enzyme systems; lot documentation reports spectrophotometric identity and purity.
